Order Book Lab

A sequential BTC limit order book with price-time priority: a transparent list-scan baseline (Version A) against price levels with a fast path (Version B). Every number is read from saved results; changing a view never reruns an experiment.
Median of 5 timed repeats after 1 warmup · fresh empty book per replay · fresh process per configuration · parsing timed separately (total = parse + replay) · for buildup and crowded the replay is the book construction · declared limit s per configuration.

The book is restored from a snapshot before every trial (reset timed separately). Sell time covers matching, state updates and fill-list construction. Work: fills = makers touched · L = price levels visited · work steps = list entries scanned (A) or fills + levels (B).

tracemalloc, separate from timing. Replay peak and book after (structures) trace from after the input is loaded: the input is excluded, but ids and ints the book keeps from the parser are then not counted. Book after (incl. ids/ints) traces from before loading and drops the input afterwards; bytes per order use it. No trade history is kept. Traced bytes are neither pure auxiliary space nor total process memory.
